status_definitions.TESTED_CALCULATION: Formula/code test only; does not validate business lead, rate, quote, customs treatment or credit outcome.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Code exists but external evidence or full workflow remains unverified.
status_definitions.PROPOSED: Methodology/workflow available; not yet independently validated for a live engagement.

hotel-energy.formula: corporate_rate = BAR * (1 - discount) * longstay_factor; commission scenario = (BAR - corporate_rate) + BAR * 0.10
sources: STR/CoStar hospitality benchmarking (licensed; current source page not verified)
hotel-energy.lead_evidence: Fouad Hotel, 15 El Shohadaa St, Raml Station, Alexandria; EGP 290-1,000/night and Miramar association are user-supplied, not independently confirmed. Aelat Adaa, Raml Station, is user-reported local lead; address, identity, rates and availability unverified.
hotel-energy.validity: Scenario planning only until property identity, rate, taxes, availability, terms and affiliation are confirmed in writing.

freight-forwarding.formula: landed cost = FOB + freight + insurance + origin/destination charges + duties/taxes + other evidenced fees; scenario sell price = landed cost * (1 + margin)
sources: ICC Incoterms 2020 (official rules; specific rule and contract must be checked)
Egyptian Customs Authority tariff/classification and applicable tax rules (verify for shipment date)
freight-forwarding.commercial_model: ELAFLEX 70/30 is a proposed split only; written party roles, collection trigger, costs, tax, liability and commission agreement required.
freight-forwarding.validity: Calculation code only. No freight rate, customs duty, tax, supplier relationship or 70/30 agreement is verified by this status.

sources: Altman, Financial Ratios, Discriminant Analysis and the Prediction of Corporate Bankruptcy (1968); original model definitions and population must be matched

financial-diagnosis.validity: Original model is not universal; use only with matching variable definitions and original public-manufacturing domain. Screening, not a lending decision.
